scheduleEndCases.name: a full day ends after the break it spans
a half day ends an hour past the break
a quarter day ends before the break
a quarter day overlapping the break resumes after it
a start inside the break counts from the end of it
adjacent breaks are stepped over together
a day with two breaks lays both on top of the target
a day without breaks is the target added to the start
a target consumed just before midnight is allowed
a target landing exactly on midnight is refused
a target running past midnight is refused
asking for no minutes returns the start untouched
